notation: All local checks use p=target and q=actual proposal. Chen et al. use q=target and p=draft, so their symbols must be reversed before comparison.

checked_facts: Sampling probabilities refer to distributions after sampling-policy adjustments.
Acceptance and positive-part residual correction recover the target distribution.
Published geometric length simplification explicitly assumes iid acceptance rates.
Walltime result assumes enough concurrency, draft cost, and sufficiently long generation; arithmetic work may increase.
sources.read_scope: Only listed algorithm, analysis, proof sections checked for this acceptance task; no claim to have reviewed every experiment or appendix.

checked_facts: Independent derivation uses draft accept-or-resample decomposition.
Rejection probability equals positive-part residual normalizer.
Sequential application and extra target token after full draft acceptance are described.
Numerical implementation is qualified by hardware numerics.
sources.read_scope: Listed correctness sections checked, not a reproduction of model results.

independent_work: All numeric cases, wrong-policy counterexamples, event-law enumeration, EOS/budget examples, and conditional-tail/cost arithmetic were authored independently of the research owner's candidates. These finite checks are not formal verification.
